title: Make the manager page readable: label every row and column
notes: Worktree rows, terminal rows and the token columns have no headings; the week bars have no days; 'quiet' is unexplained; the confirm dialog stretches to full height.

comments.body: Shipped in PR #65: column names over terminals and worktrees, named token figures, weekday letters, blank status for quiet panes, 'nothing waiting', box-drawing prompts skipped, title-first worktree rows, confirm dialog height and focus ring fixed. v1.6.0.

Also in PR #65: once a card's review has landed it in Done, the app removes its worktree (branch kept, never forced) as soon as no pane has a shell left in it. If git refuses over uncommitted files, the card says so and the worktree stays on the worktree list.
